description: A shell script for running various stress tests using stress-ng on a device, including CPU, memory, disk I/O, network, and other system stress tests, with logging and resource management.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and script basename to the log file.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Ends metrics capture, cleans up workspace, and logs end of tests.

methods.name: logUptime
methods.description: Logs system uptime to the log file.

methods.name: logMem
methods.description: Logs memory status to the log file.

methods.name: execAndRedirectOut
methods.description: Executes a command, logs start and end, and redirects output to log file.

methods.name: cpuStressTest
methods.description: Runs CPU stress tests with stress-ng based on device type.

methods.name: thermalZoneTests
methods.description: Runs thermal zone stress tests (currently TBD).

methods.name: pageFaultTests
methods.description: Runs page fault and system fault stress tests.

methods.name: memoryPressureTest
methods.description: Performs memory pressure tests to check application OOM handling.

methods.name: getStressExeSize
methods.description: Logs the size of the stress-ng executable.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes environment, cleans logs, starts stress tests sequence.
